fk_decisions.proposed_control: Disable integration and revoke credentials first; forbid direct hard-delete until dependency and retention review
Revoke credentials, preserve key lifecycle evidence; hard-delete only via later approved retention process
Preserve approvals and revocations under reviewed legal hold and minimization policy
Remove implicit cascade before release or provide independently retained and access-controlled audit archive
Retain unexpired windows to prevent quota-reset abuse; define eventual cleanup separately
Define dedupe horizon and prohibit deletion while linked events or retries are live
No cascade deletion while event chain is held, pending, or under investigation
No cascade deletion before reconciliation of pending and dead-letter delivery
Preserve nonce deduplication during its security window; cleanup only by reviewed TTL
Preserve attempt and failure evidence outside implicit parent-deletion cascades
